title: PASSIVE SKILLS
intro: Right now: miles, physiology, politics, and quality time with the family — the rest are readings from another life:

familia.name: +FAMILY
familia.body: My daughters. The best project, the one that takes the most time — and love.

running.name: +RUNNING & PHYSIOLOGY
running.body: Zone 2, threshold, mitochondria — running as an excuse to understand my own metabolism.

lifestyle.name: +LIFESTYLE
lifestyle.body: Homemade kefir and local organic produce — what I eat builds me and my environment.

politica.name: +ROOTS & HORIZONS
politica.body: Cooperativism and local conscious consumption — food and energy sovereignty, the fight against gentrification, and building more human, equitable and sustainable economic and organizational models.

arts.name: +CREATIVE ARTS
arts.body: Video, motion, live sound & radio — a past creative life.

nlp.name: +NLP
nlp.body: Bandler & Grinder — the map is not the territory.
